title: 第532章 拖延时间第531章 时在前空在后
lines: 好了。
疑惑都整明白，现在的问题则是如何拖延时间。
不真正成仙确实无法抗衡那么多人，但老祖也琢磨出其他意思。
假设小心领悟了上千条大道，即便还是无法抗衡那么多人，届时她也会成为很特殊的存在。
没有短板，她可以为自身掩盖天机变成一个刺客逐个清除敌人。
至于让她一直待在老祖身边，由老祖帮她掩盖天机，就这么一直躲下去的办法可以直接剔除。
树哥确实不凡，但老祖无法主动去操控它。
昔年小马被杀之后，紫云仙宗元婴修士一起出动神识探查。
假设老祖当年真炼了葵花宝典，当时肯定就会被揪出来。
现在的情况也是一样，老祖除了自身外无法以任何形式庇护其他人。
这些界主只会比当初的紫云仙宗更加疯狂。
在他们广阔的神识和高端用法之下，整个世界都将无所遁形。
掘地三尺，所有秘境和所有异端全都会被挖出来。
老祖若是隐藏于凡间，给自身配上一个凡人水平的灵魂自然没问题，而且还不能携带任何形式的储物装备，包括但不限于小世界和早年的几件装人物品。
他们的掘地三尺其实就是找不同游戏，老祖一旦有任何与凡人不同都会被挖出来。
不要以为混进修士里伪装储物装备就能蒙混过去，他们甚至可以直接搜索所有底层修士的储物装备。
综上所述，那就是除了老祖自身之外，一切都是瞒不住的。
地球会暴露，白小飞也会被挖出来。
怎么看，都好像是死局。
但天衍四九，遁去其一，一切皆有可能。
老祖自身就是遁去的那其一，只要他活着便有逆转一切那一天。
让小心独自去面对，肯定是不可能的。
老祖让她把青木界放回原位，毕竟现在事情还没暴露，这种行为无异于不打自招，暴露的第一时间就会显示出青木仙宗这个异端。
她只是个成道才几个轮回的小角色，光是这一点就能拖延不少时间。
现在也只有尽可能去拖延时间了，一旦小心跨越进另一个层次，那才是不同光景。
小心听话照做，把青木仙宗放回去之后便回到老祖身边闭关。
而老祖呢，他亲自出马去了一趟轩辕氏和天机阁的遗址。
系统现在能做到很多连老祖都做不到的事情。
他配合系统出手直接在这两个地方再次伪装出空间节点，然后掩盖天机的同时更是留下一些讯息，表明他们已经封山闭关。
虽然迟早会被揭穿，毕竟这一个家族一个门派又不是没有社交的孤寡老人，但这么做也多少可以拖延一些时间。
这一点完成以后，老祖继续思索该如何拖延时间。
这两个地方暴露以后，必须有一个什么东西转移他们的视线，这样一来就能延缓这个暴雷。
又到帝释天这个马甲出场的时候了。
content_en:
alright.
All the doubts have been cleared up, now the problem is how to delay time.
It is true that one cannot compete with so many people without becoming an immortal, but the ancestor also figured out other meanings.
Assuming that she has understood thousands of avenues, even if she still cannot compete with so many people, she will become a very special being.
She has no shortcomings, she can cover up her secrets and become an assassin to eliminate enemies one by one.
As for letting her stay with the ancestor all the time, and let the ancestor help her cover up the secret, the method of hiding all the time can be eliminated directly.
Brother Shu is indeed extraordinary, but the ancestor cannot take the initiative to control it.
After Xiao Ma was killed in the past, the Yuanying monks from the Ziyun Immortal Sect set out to investigate with their spiritual consciousness.
Assuming that the ancestor really practiced the Sunflower Book back then, he would have been found out at that time.
The current situation is the same. The ancestor cannot protect others in any form except himself.
These realm masters will only be crazier than the original Ziyun Immortal Sect.
Under their vast spiritual consciousness and high-end usage, the entire world will be invisible.
Dig three feet into the ground, and all secret realms and all heresies will be dug out.
If the ancestor was hiding in the mortal world, it would be no problem to equip himself with a mortal-level soul, and he would not be able to carry any form of storage equipment, including but not limited to the small world and a few personal items from his early years.
Their Digging Three Feet is actually a game of spotting differences. If the ancestor is any different from ordinary people, he will be dug out.
Don't think that you can get away by sneaking into the monks and pretending to be storage equipment. They can even directly search for the storage equipment of all low-level monks.
To sum up, it means that except the ancestor himself, nothing can be hidden.
The earth will be exposed and Bai Xiaofei will be dug out.
No matter how you look at it, it seems to be a dead end.
But if one of Tianyan's four nines can escape, everything is possible.
The ancestor himself is one of the ones who escaped. As long as he lives, there will be a day when everything can be reversed.
It is definitely impossible for Xin Xing to face it alone.
The ancestor asked her to put the Aoki Realm back to its original position. After all, the matter has not been exposed yet. This kind of behavior is tantamount to self-inflicted trouble. The first time it is exposed, it will show the heresy of the Aoki Immortal Sect.
She is just a small character who has only been around for a few reincarnations. This alone can delay a lot of time.
Now we can only delay as much time as possible. Once we carefully cross to another level, it will be a different situation.
Be careful to obey and do as you are told, and after putting the Qingmu Immortal Sect back, return to your ancestor for seclusion.
As for the ancestor, he personally went to the ruins of Xuanyuan Clan and Tianji Pavilion.
The system can now do many things that even the ancestors could not do.
He cooperated with the system to directly disguise the space nodes in these two places again, and then covered up the secret while leaving some messages indicating that they had closed the mountain for retreat.
Although it will be exposed sooner or later, after all, this family and sect are not lonely old people without social contact, but doing so can delay some time.
After completing this, the ancestor continued to think about how to delay time.
After these two places are exposed, something must divert their attention, so that the thunderstorm can be delayed.
It's time for the vest of Emperor Shakti to appear again.
title_en: Chapter 532 Delaying time Chapter 531 Time is ahead and time is behind
